svg.title: FIG-07 STM32F407 finite DMA completion order Top-to-bottom order; task service and IRQ separate; cancellation retains borrow
svg.desc: USART1 TX: DMA2 stream7 channel4; Task: validate submit / admit ACCEPTED borrows request + payload; Task: configure TX DMA / UART DMAT DMA writes UART DR; UART shifts bits onto the wire; DMA IRQ: observe TC / NDTR / errors Withdraw DMAT and DMA source; observe actual EN; UART IRQ: independently observe real TC Latch wire completion and deadline facts; Task service: drain EN / IRQ source / TC Final error observation; detach active references; Final release-publication of SETTLED Task acquire-observes and reads final result/count; UART cancel / deadline / DMA error Withdraw DMAT / DMA source; retain request and payload; UART drain not proven: QUARANTINED Retain DMA / IRQ / execution and recovery responsibility; Termination event; Only after actual UART drain is established; Budget exhausted without proven drain; Valid admission; DMA phase complete, not wire TC; TC only after the final serial bit leaves; Executor explicitly advances; All necessary references detached; SPI1: RX stream0 / TX stream3, DMA2 channel3; Task: admit + select endpoint Exclusive TX/RX buffers and controller; Task: enable RX before TX Bidirectional DMA progress; retain CS; Two DMA IRQs: observe each TC separately Disable each engine / IRQ source separately; Task service: actual BSY=0 and TXE=1 Both engines drained; check late errors; Task: withdraw SPI DMA/SPE, clear state Issue CS release; detach active/endpoint references; Final release-publication of SETTLED Task acquire-observes and reads final result/count; SPI cancel / deadline / DMA error Withdraw both DMA and SPI write sources; retain request / buffers; SPI drain not proven: QUARANTINED Retain engines / IRQ / CS and recovery responsibility; Termination event; Check actual SPI / both-engine drain; Budget exhausted without proven drain; Valid admission; RX/TX complete separately; TC does not replace peripheral idle; Drain conditions established; Final provider access
